data.narrative:
Ark Robotics is a seed-stage company operating in the Defense & Security sector. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 5 companies at seed and adjacent Series A stages within the same sector, supplemented by reference to a broader universe of 10 private and 2 public comparables including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method serves as the primary valuation approach given data availability. The five-company peer cohort—comprising Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Castelion ($1.0B, Series A), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yields a median valuation of $1.0B. This method reflects the range observed across comparable-stage Defense & Security companies, which spans from $125M to $4.0B. Only one triangulation method is supported by available data, limiting the depth of cross-verification.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.1B, centered on the $1.0B peer median. This range reflects reasonable variance around the peer benchmark while acknowledging the discrete sample size. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue, profitability, or growth-rate data for either Ark Robotics or its peers, limiting defensibility of any single-point estimate within the range. The seed-stage classification also introduces execution risk not captured in comparable valuations.
